headline: Virbac to Acquire Axiota Animal Health to Expand U.S. Ruminant Market Footprint
summary: Virbac is set to acquire Axiota Animal Health, a US-based company generating approximately USD 65 million in revenue, to build a global platform for cattle health solutions.
why: Corporate acquisitions allow companies to expand their geographic reach, enter new product segments, and consolidate market share within specific industries.
